source: MediaPipe hand landmarker (tasks-vision 0.10.14, float16 model 1), webcam
joints: mediapipe-21: wrist; thumb cmc mcp ip tip; then index, middle, ring, pinky as mcp pip dip tip
world: millimetres about the hand's centre: x right, y down, z away from the camera, as the camera sees it (not mirrored)
image: 1/10000 of the frame's width and height from its top left, z on the same scale as x (smaller is nearer)
